title: Engineering Manager - Core Commerce Platform
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.

  

**Your mission**
----------------

**About the Organisation & Role:**

You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing & fulfilment and post-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. Through a portfolio of commerce platform capabilities, the organisation enables seamless omnichannel experiences while supporting efficient, scalable, and resilient commerce operations across the global digital ecosystem.

The Engineering Manager is accountable for engineering delivery, roadmap execution, operational excellence, and engineering team development. Partnering with Product Owners, Project Managers, Tech Leads, and peer engineering teams, you will enable predictable delivery, grow engineering talent, and build a high-performing culture focused on ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  
  

**What you will do:**

* Lead and develop a team of software engineers building basket, checkout, payments, and consumer commerce services.

* Drive delivery of highly available, secure, and scalable commerce services that directly impact conversion, revenue, and consumer experience.

* Own engineering execution for payment gateway integrations, alternative payment methods, checkout orchestration, promotions, taxation, and transactional commerce workflows.

* Drive planning and execution against team objectives and key results (OKRs), ensuring alignment, accountability and transparent reporting.

* Own sprint execution, delivery planning, capacity management, dependency management, and risk management.

* Partner with Product Owners, Project Managers, Retail Tech team, and Tech Leads to deliver business outcomes.

* Drive engineering excellence through strong development practices, quality standards, operational discipline and continuous improvement.

* Coach engineers through regular feedback, mentoring, performance management, and career development.

* Build a high-performing engineering culture focused on ownership, accountability, collaboration, and learning.

* Establish effective engineering metrics and use data to improve team productivity, quality, and delivery predictability.

* Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and automation to improve productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.

* Identify opportunities to leverage AI across software development, testing, documentation, knowledge management and onboarding.

* Collaborate with engineering leadership on hiring, staffing, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.

* Manage delivery partners and vendors where applicable and ensure alignment with team objectives.

**Your talent**
---------------

10+ years of software engineering experience, with experience leading engineering teams in an agile delivery environment.

* 3+ years of people leadership experience.

* Strong experience leading roadmap execution, delivery planning, dependency management, and stakeholder engagement.

* Familiarity with API-first, cloud-native architectures and design patterns.

* Solid software engineering background with experience building APIs, distributed systems, and high-volume transactional platforms.

* Strong understanding of basket, checkout, payment processing, promotions, pricing, taxation, and other commerce services within modern eCommerce platforms.

* Experience integrating with payment gateways, fraud prevention providers, financial service providers, and third-party commerce platforms.

* Understanding of payment security, tokenisation, authentication, PCI-DSS principles, and secure transaction processing practices.

* Experience working with event-driven architectures, high-volume transactional systems, and enterprise integrations.

* Strong people leadership skills with experience in hiring, mentoring, developing, and retaining high-performing engineering teams.

* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices including software architecture & engineering principles, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, and AI-assisted development.

* Strong communication, collaboration, decision-making, and organisational leadership skills.

* Experience driving engineering quality, operational excellence, reliability, security, and continuous improvement.

* Experience working in Agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira & Confluence or equivalent.

* A data-driven mindset with the ability to use engineering, delivery, and operational metrics to improve team effectiveness and predictability.

* Experience leveraging coding agents, LLMs, and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and team productivity will be a strong advantage.

* Experience in global DTC, retail, omnichannel commerce or high-volume consumer digital environment preferred.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.

**Our principles**
------------------

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.

At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.

PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

title: Data Platform Engineering Manager
description:
**Job description**

**Engineering Manager, Data Platform**
--------------------------------------

Johnson Controls is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the India-based engineers of the data platform team within the Open Blue Data Platform (OBDP). The team owns the streaming, storage, and lakehouse foundation that carries building telemetry and operational data for Open Blue's smart-building applications. This role partners closely with the Data Platform Engines team, application teams, SRE, security, and product to deliver a reliable, scalable, and secure data foundation.

**Role Overview**

In this role, you will lead a data platform engineering team, working closely with US-based peers and leadership, with shared responsibility for designing and operating the platform's core data layer: Kafka and Flink streaming pipelines, Spark data processing, the Apache Iceberg lakehouse, and time-series storage. You will shape the team's roadmap through PI planning, improve engineering and operational practices, and ensure the platform can support both current tenants and future growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, delivery, and evolution of the OBDP data platform architecture, including streaming, storage, and lakehouse layers.
* Manage a team of 3-5 data platform engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
* Partner with product management on the roadmap and PI planning, coordinating dependencies with the Engines team, application teams, and product stakeholders.
* Oversee event-driven pipelines on Kafka and Flink and batch and incremental processing on Spark.
* Define standards for data modeling, partitioning, retention, lifecycle management, access control, and data quality.
* Guide time-series and operational storage patterns, including Timescale DB, PostgreSQL, and Iceberg.
* Ensure reliable deployment and operations on Azure, including AKS, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and multi-region rollouts.
* Improve observability, reliability, and performance, with clear SLOs, on-call practices, and root cause analysis.
* Promote effective use of AI-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) with sound review practices.
* Mentor engineers and strengthen team capability through coaching, code review, design review, and knowledge sharing.

**How You Will Do It**

* You will own your outcomes with accountability, safety, and integrity, making clear decisions and following through on commitments.
* You will stay close to the work, remove obstacles quickly, and keep priorities focused on what delivers the most value to customers and application teams.
* You will improve every day by using data, candid feedback, and structured problem-solving to simplify processes and strengthen the platform.
* You will win as one team by building trust across engineering, product, SRE, security, and across US and India time zones, and by valuing diverse perspectives.
* You will set clear technical standards and help the team execute them consistently across design, build, and operations.
* You will balance strategy with hands-on leadership, ensuring architecture decisions translate into reliable delivery and measurable results.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or platform engineering, including 3+ years leading engineering teams.
* Experience managing teams in India that collaborate closely with US-based counterparts, with responsibility for delivery, quality, and team development.
* Strong knowledge of event-driven data pipelines and streaming frameworks such as Kafka and Flink.
* Hands-on understanding of Spark, lakehouse table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi), data warehouses such as Snowflake, and time-series storage.
* Experience designing and operating cloud-native data platforms, with Azure preferred.
* Experience with data governance, security, encryption, access control, and compliance in enterprise environments.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or Bicep.
* Experience planning and delivering in a scaled agile (SAFe/PI planning) environment.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to align technical teams and business stakeholders.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience leading large data migrations, such as warehouse-to-lakehouse cutovers.
* Experience with IoT, telemetry, or real-time data such as building automation, energy, or BMS.
* Exposure to Trino, GraphQL, or Datadog, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Background in SaaS or multi-tenant platform design.

title: Head of Global Banking Technology Engineering
description:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Head of Global Banking Technology Engineering

**The Opportunity**

The Head of Global Banking Technology Engineering is responsible for leading the engineering function across Global Banking Technology, providing strategic, operational and people leadership for a global organisation of approximately 300 engineers supporting Capital Markets & Advisory, CRM, Omnia and Infrastructure Finance & Sustainability.

The role is accountable for defining and executing the engineering strategy, ensuring the consistent adoption of engineering standards, modern software development practices, architecture principles and operational excellence across all technology domains. Working closely with Business, Product, Architecture and Technology leadership teams, the role ensures technology delivery aligns with business objectives while maintaining a strong focus on resilience, security, scalability and regulatory compliance.

The role will champion the responsible adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, automation and emerging engineering technologies to improve developer productivity, accelerate delivery, enhance operational effectiveness and support innovation across the Global Banking Technology organisation. The successful candidate will foster a culture of experimentation and continuous learning whilst ensuring AI capabilities are leveraged appropriately within governance, security, risk and regulatory frameworks.

As a senior technology leader, the role serves as a key member of the Global Banking Technology leadership team, driving engineering transformation, talent development, workforce strategy and delivery performance globally.

**What you’ll do**

Strategy and Leadership

* Define and run the engineering strategy for Global Banking Technology (Capital Markets and Advisory (CMA), CRM, Omnia and Marketing, Infrastructure Finance & Sustainability), in line with the bank's global technology roadmap and business priorities.
* Lead a matrix organization of engineering leads, architects, and engineers across multiple business domains.
* Anticipate how AI, automation and evolving technology landscape will reshape roles, skill mix, and team sizes and plan workforce transformation, cultural change and process changes required to adopt to changing time proactively.
* Represent CMA & FEM Technology in global leadership and engineering forums and build credibility with senior stakeholders.

Engineering Excellence and Delivery

* Own engineering delivery commitments across the portfolio: quality, cost efficiency, and time to market.
* Enable the Digital transformation of CMA Technology by delivering Digital capabilities to customers and delivering / maturing Agile Ways of Working across Technology and inform, assist the business to adopt these practices alongside technology.
* Drive adoption of modern engineering practices. Example, AI adoption, Resiliency, Technology risk management, CI/CD, DevSecOps, test automation, etc.
* Set and track engineering metrics, such as DORA metrics, defect leakage, availability, and productivity, and use them to drive continuous improvement.
* Lead modernization and enterprise estate simplification programmes: microservices, API-first architecture, and legacy decommissioning.
* Champion / lead responsible adoption of emerging technologies including AI coding assistants, agentic workflows etc. Put clear guardrails in place for security, data protection and model risk.
* Keep a forward-looking view of the technology landscape and make pragmatic build, buy or partner decisions.

Risk, Controls, and Governance

* Make sure all engineering work meets the organization’s technology risk, information security, and data privacy standards, and applicable regulations.
* Partner with Risk, Audit, Compliance, and CISO teams to remediate findings and keep a strong control environment.
* Recognize frontier AI models find and weaponize vulnerabilities faster than before. Identify and implement tooling / process so the organization can patch / mitigate at a comparable speed.
* Maintain a strong control environment with timely closure of audit and risk findings, clear risk ownerships, and transparent risk reporting to leadership.

Operation Resilience

* Own production platforms and operational resilience end to end for all services governed by Global Banking including incident management, disaster recovery, business continuity and ensuring organization can stay within tolerances.
* Ensure compliance with applicable global and regional regulatory frameworks.
* Embed site reliability engineering practices, strong observability and automated remediation to reduce manual toil and operation risk.
* Own regular scenario testing, disaster recovery exercises and failover drills and ensure lessons learned are implemented and read across the organization.

People and Culture

* Management responsibility for all Global Banking engineering staff globally.
* Attract, develop, and retain top engineering talent. Build strong leadership succession and technical career paths.
* Promote a culture of ownership, innovation, inclusion, and psychological safety.
* Invest in structured reskilling and upskilling in evolving technology and industry practices so that existing talent grows with the organization and industry.
* Build succession plans and a strong leadership bench for critical roles.

Leadership Competencies

* Strategic thinker who can turn global priorities into actionable local roadmaps.
* Knowledge of the financial services industry and global marketplace.
* Delivery of Complex Change: have consistently demonstrated the successful management and delivery of complex transformational change.
* Operational Resilience: Have shown strong ability to adapt and operate through disruptive change. Agile critical thinker able to lead through change at pace and with resilience.
* Executive presence and influence across geographies and cultures.
* Balances speed of innovation with control and risk discipline.
* Leader who builds people and scales organisations through others.
* Data-driven decision-maker with strong commercial skills.

**What you will need to succeed in the role:**

  

* A strategic leader with deep knowledge of the financial services technology, ideally experienced in Capital Markets, CRM, Global Banking or similar product lines.
* A broad and comprehensive understanding of the different systems, theories and practices relevant to technology
* Requires very strong abilities in critical thinking, creativity, and innovation in developing new concepts, theories, and products to address complex and strategic issues
* Delivery of Complex Change: Have consistently demonstrated the successful management and delivery of complex transformational change both regionally and globally
* Operational Resilience: Have shown strong ability to adapt and operate through disruptive change. Agile critical thinker able to lead through change at pace and with resilience.
* Degree level education – probably in Technology, Engineering or related STEM field.

**You’ll achieve more when you are at HSBC.**

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:
**Who we are**

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. #VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Agentic AI Lead to drive the design, development and delivery of enterprise-scale agentic AI solutions across Vodafone’s Corporate AI Portfolio. This role will play a key part in shaping the future of AskHR, Vodafone’s AI-powered HR assistant, by defining agent architectures, advancing multi-agent orchestration across Google Cloud and Microsoft Copilot ecosystems, and creating reusable AI patterns for broader corporate functions. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on engineering leadership, enabling the delivery of secure, scalable and high-quality AI experiences that enhance employee productivity and experience globally.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

### **Agentic AI Engineering**

* Design, develop and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions, ranging from single-agent implementations to complex multi-agent systems.
* Implement advanced capabilities including tool and function calling, planning, memory management and agent orchestration.
* Apply emerging interoperability standards such as Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

### **Architecture & Knowledge Management**

* Evolve the AskHR AI architecture across Vertex AI Agent Builder, Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Engine and Gemini, integrating seamlessly with Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Drive improvements in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), grounding quality, chunking strategies, metadata filtering and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* Lead the transition from structured workflow-driven experiences to conversational, agent-led interactions.

### **Quality, Security & Operations**

* Establish robust evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, regression testing and conversation analytics.
* Implement observability frameworks, performance monitoring and cost optimisation strategies.
* Embed responsible AI principles, privacy-by-design practices, GDPR compliance, prompt-injection protection and enterprise security controls.
* Define and implement LLMOps practices and CI/CD processes for prompts, agents and knowledge pipelines.

### **Technical Leadership**

* Mentor and support engineers across multiple squads through code reviews, technical guidance and engineering standards.
* Collaborate with architects, conversation designers, product owners and business stakeholders to align technical strategy with business objectives.
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and industry developments.

### **Initial Focus Areas**

* Define and secure adoption of a target agentic architecture across HR, Google Cloud, Copilot Studio and SAP platforms.
* Accelerate onboarding of HR journeys and knowledge sources through improved ingestion capabilities.
* Deliver scalable content ingestion pipelines that significantly reduce onboarding time for new data sources.
* Introduce evaluation-led release processes that improve answer quality and user containment rates.
* Prototype innovative employee experiences and contribute to the FY28 AI roadmap.

### **Broader Business Impact**

* Develop reusable agentic AI components, accelerators and reference architectures for HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Legal and other corporate domains.
* Provide technical leadership across expanding AI portfolios and support the scaling of successful AI solutions throughout the organisation.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Essential Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in senior software engineering, machine learning engineering or AI platform development, typically gained over 8+ years.
* Proven hands-on experience delivering production-scale generative AI, LLM and agentic AI solutions.
* Strong programming expertise in Python, with TypeScript experience considered advantageous.
* Deep expertise in either Google Cloud AI technologies (Vertex AI, Agent Builder, ADK, Gemini) or Microsoft AI technologies (Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework), alongside working knowledge of the alternative ecosystem.
* Strong understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, API design and enterprise integrations.
* Experience with cloud-native development, including containers, serverless platforms, infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices.
* Expertise in AI evaluation methodologies, observability platforms and production AI monitoring.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and supporting the growth of engineering talent.

### **Desirable Skills & Experience**

* Experience delivering AI solutions within HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement or other corporate functions.
* Knowledge of SAP integrations, including SAP SuccessFactors and SAP BTP.
* Experience with ServiceNow or comparable enterprise workflow platforms.
* Exposure to multilingual conversational AI solutions, regulated environments and global deployments.
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph or CrewAI.
* Relevant Google Cloud or Microsoft certifications.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

Opportunity to define and influence the future state of enterprise agentic AI architecture across a global organisation.Exposure to cutting-edge technologies spanning Google Cloud AI, Microsoft Copilot, Generative AI and multi-agent systems.Collaboration with global AI, architecture, HR and digital transformation teams.Opportunity to drive innovation through proof-of-concepts, experimentation and emerging technology adoption.Ability to create reusable solutions with impact across multiple business functions and global markets.Continuous learning within a rapidly evolving AI and cloud technology landscape.

------------------------------

Advanced multi-agent architecture design and orchestration.Enterprise-scale implementation of Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).AI governance, responsible AI frameworks and secure enterprise AI deployment practices.End-to-end LLMOps, AI observability and automated evaluation methodologies.Integration of AI agents across SAP, Copilot Studio, Google Cloud and enterprise platforms.Scalable knowledge management, RAG optimisation and conversational AI design techniques.Strategic technology planning and AI portfolio leadership.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Job description:**

**Data Platform Engineer**
--------------------------

At Johnson Controls, you will help build and operate the data platform behind OpenBlue, our smart-building platform. In this role, you will build the streaming and lakehouse pipelines that deliver trusted building and energy data to the applications our customers rely on.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer with 3+ years of experience to build, deploy, and maintain pipelines on the OpenBlue Data Platform (OBDP). You will work with Kafka, Flink, Spark, Apache Iceberg, and Snowflake alongside senior engineers, and help run them on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with CI/CD and infrastructure as code. This is a hands-on role where you will own well-scoped features end to end, from code to production, and take on more design ownership over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain Kafka and Flink streaming jobs for ingestion and transformation.
* Develop and maintain Spark jobs for data processing tasks.
* Write unit and integration tests and contribute to CI pipelines.
* Fix production defects and support SIT, UAT, and deployments.
* Deploy and operate data services and jobs on AKS using Helm and Kubernetes operators.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
* Set up monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for pipelines and services (Datadog, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Support routine database and lakehouse operations, including Iceberg table maintenance and PostgreSQL backups and tuning.

**How You Will Do It**

* Own the outcome with accountability by delivering well-tested features and following through on commitments.
* Stay close to work by understanding how the data you build is used downstream.
* Look for root causes, improve continuously, and raise issues with candor.
* Work as one team by partnering with engineers, QA, and product, sharing context, and asking for help early.
* Use clear documentation and disciplined engineering practices to support consistency and handoffs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in software or data engineering.
* Hands-on experience with at least two of Kafka, Flink, Spark, Iceberg, or Snowflake, with working knowledge of or eagerness to learn the rest.
* Proficiency in Java, Scala, or Python, and solid SQL skills.
* Understanding of distributed systems basics such as partitioning, fault tolerance, and idempotency.
* Experience with Git, code review, and agile/Jira workflows.
* Hands-on AI-assisted development with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar, with a critical eye for generated code.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines in a cloud environment.
* Exposure to Trino, PostgreSQL, or TimescaleDB.
* Experience with React and TypeScript.
* Azure experience.
* Production experience with AKS, Helm, or Kubernetes operators for Flink, Spark, or Kafka.
* Experience with time-series or IoT data.
* Experience with Terraform or Bicep and GitOps tools (Flux or Argo CD).
* Azure networking and security basics, including VNets, private endpoints, Key Vault, and Entra ID.

title: Pipeline Technical Director
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Pipeline TD is responsible for developing and maintaining software tools, providing front-line support to artists, and general troubleshooting of the CG pipeline in a fast-paced, feature film visual effects production environment. The primary focus is ensuring artist efficiency. Receives day-to-day direction and priorities from show CG Supervisor; reports to R&D supervisor for technical and career guidance.

**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities**
-------------------------------------------------

* Develop pipeline and asset management tools to meet immediate, show-directed production demands, ensuring facility-wide consistency as directed by show and technical supervisors. Help maintain a wide array of existing workflows and scripts.
* Provide front-line production support across a wide range of disciplines, troubleshoot assets and shots, and help artists with general problem-solving. Monitor email requests, package up problems and redirect to the appropriate engineering team.
* Test and validate tools and techniques in production. Work closely with engineering teams in testing, and releasing new and modified software systems.
* Act as an on-call resource for show production staff.
* Collaborate effectively with artists, production supervisors, and technical staff across ILM studios in San Francisco, Vancouver, Singapore, and London.
* When not crewed to shows, serve on software teams working on projects that improve the efficiency of asset setup, caching, and shot-data handoff between artists across the entire pipeline.
* Identify day-to-day priorities in conjunction with show supervisors; act autonomously.
* Work primarily on tools of a high degree of complexity, requiring broad understanding of the larger pipeline.
* Assist junior Pipeline TDs in providing front-line support; resolve complex user errors; guide Pipeline Engineers and R&D with debugging technical issues.
* Develop comprehensive knowledge of software and systems; contribute to evolving standards and conventions used in production.
* Update documentation for the pipeline and tools to reflect any changes that are made.

**Education/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining tools for use in a computer graphics environment.
* At least 5 years production experience in visual effects for film, commercials or television.

**Required Skills/Competencies**

* Proficiency in Linux
* Advanced Python scripting required
* Experience in one or more of Maya, Nuke, Houdini, Mari, Katana, RenderMan or similar
* Ability to communicate cross-discipline and provide innovative solutions to pipeline issues.
* Detail oriented and strong self-sufficient troubleshooter.

title: Infrastructure Engineer II – eApps
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

• **Support, maintain, and improve** third-party Enterprise Applications infrastructure through platform operations, administration, automation, monitoring, and cross-team delivery.

• **Own assigned operational activities with increasing independence** while following approved standards and partnering with senior engineers on complex issues, platform improvements, and project delivery.

• **Contribute to Infrastructure as Code and automation** using Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, and PowerShell to improve repeatability, reliability, and support efficiency.

• **Work closely with senior team members, infrastructure teams, application stakeholders, and vendors** to deliver stable services and build technical capability across E-Apps operations.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

• **Platform operations:** Support the health, availability, administration, monitoring, and continuous improvement of assigned E-Apps platforms.

• **Administration and maintenance:** Perform platform configuration, patching, upgrades, certificate updates, service management, access changes, backup checks, and routine maintenance across Windows and Linux environments.

• **Web and application platforms:** Administer and troubleshoot IIS, JBoss, and Apache, including application hosting, configuration, reverse proxy settings, ports, certificates, service restarts, and basic Java application troubleshooting.

• **Cloud and infrastructure:** Work with GCP resources and approved hybrid infrastructure patterns involving compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, SSL/TLS, storage, and connectivity.

• **Automation:** Create and maintain Terraform configurations, Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell or PowerShell scripts for repeatable operational tasks and standard process execution.

• **Observability and performance:** Use Datadog or equivalent tools to review metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, health checks, and performance indicators; identify trends and escalate abnormal conditions.

• **Incident and ITSM support:** Resolve routine and moderately complex incidents, participate in incident and change processes, maintain knowledge articles and runbooks, and escalate issues with clear evidence and impact details.

• **Project delivery:** Support infrastructure and application activities for assigned projects, deployments, testing, environment readiness, and operational handover.

• **Continuous improvement:** Identify opportunities to improve reliability, patch compliance, monitoring, recovery readiness, documentation, and standard operating procedures.

• **Collaboration:** Work effectively with D&T, network, OS, security, application, and vendor teams while sharing operational knowledge and following platform standards.

• **Support Requirement:** Participate in extended off-hours shift coverage, including overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

• **Education:** Full-time graduation in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.

• **Experience:** Minimum 6 years of total IT experience, including at least 4 years supporting infrastructure or enterprise application platforms in production and business-critical environments.

• **GCP and infrastructure:** Hands-on experience with GCP services, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, load balancers, SSL/TLS certificates, DNS, networking, and access management.

• **Automation and scripting:** Practical experience with Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, or PowerShell for operational support, configuration, validation, and automation.

• **Middleware and platform administration:** Working experience with IIS, JBoss, and Apache across Windows and Linux platforms, including configuration, troubleshooting, patching, service management, and application integration.

• **Operating systems and databases:** Working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration, relational database concepts, and applications using Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.

• **Monitoring and operations:** Experience with Datadog or equivalent observability tools, incident handling, patching, operational documentation, and root-cause investigation.

• **ITSM and collaboration:** Working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service request, escalation, and knowledge-management practices, with strong stakeholder communication skills.

• **Core proficiency:** Ability to manage assigned tasks effectively, troubleshoot methodically, work across teams, and build new technical skills continuously.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

• **Cloud breadth:** Exposure to AWS or Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud platform.

• **Delivery practices:** Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, DevOps practices, and release or deployment automation.

• **Project methodology:** Understanding of project delivery methods, including the Advantage project management methodology.

• **Continuous improvement:** Applies analytical thinking and AI capabilities where they provide business value to improve support, operations, and productivity.

• **Professional behaviors:** Demonstrates accountability, initiative, reliability, integrity, teamwork, learning agility, and a positive service mindset.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and featured in CRN's 2024 Security 100 list. The Senior SIEM Engineer position is an integral part of our Professional Services team. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that will focus on architecting, planning, implementing, and operationalizing the SIEM platform. Senior Manager, Process Automation COE

description:

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

  
  

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated **Senior Data Platform Engineer, AVP (Python/PySpark, Microsoft SSIS, SQL Server, ETL & Database Development)** to design, develop, enhance, and support robust, scalable, and high-performance data processing solutions.

The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on expertise in **Python/PySpark, SQL Server, ETL/data pipelines (Microsoft SSIS ), and large-scale data platforms**, with experience troubleshooting production data applications, optimizing database performance, and working across enterprise data environments.

The candidate will be working independently on complex assignments while collaborating with engineering , infrastructure, and business teams.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* **Data Pipeline & ETL Development:** Design, develop, test, and support scalable ETL/data-processing pipelines using Python/PySpark, Microsoft BI/SSIS, SQL, and related technologies.
* **SQL Server Development:** Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, data transformations, and database objects for high-volume applications.
* **Database Performance:** Identify and resolve query and database performance issues through execution-plan analysis, indexing, query optimization, statistics, and appropriate database design techniques.
* **Large-Scale Data Processing:** Develop and support solutions processing large data volumes across SQL Server and distributed data platforms.
* **Data Architecture & Modeling:** Apply relational, dimensional, and data-warehouse modeling principles to build scalable and maintainable data solutions.
* **Production Support & Troubleshooting:** Analyze failed jobs, data-quality issues, performance problems, and production incidents; perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable resolutions.
* **Job Scheduling & Automation:** Develop and support enterprise batch-processing workflows using scheduling/orchestration platforms such as AutoSys.
* **Big Data Platforms:** Work with Hadoop ecosystem technologies including HDFS, Hive and related distributed-processing technologies.
* **Data Quality & Reconciliation:** Implement validation, reconciliation, exception handling, logging, monitoring, and data-quality controls within data pipelines.
* **Code Quality:** Participate in code reviews and enforce development standards for SQL, Python/PySpark, ETL, and data-processing components.
* **DevOps:** Use Git-based source control and participate in CI/CD processes; work with container technologies such as Docker/Kubernetes where applicable.
* **Security:** Follow secure data-development practices, access-control requirements, encryption standards, and organizational security policies.
* **Technical Collaboration:** Work closely with application developers, infrastructure teams, business teams, and other technology groups to design and deliver solutions.
* **Continuous Improvement & AI:** Evaluate new technologies and leverage approved AI-assisted development tools to improve code quality, troubleshooting, refactoring, and developer productivity.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm’s reputation and safeguarding the firm, its clients, and assets while complying with applicable laws, rules, regulations, and policies.
  

  

**Recommended Qualifications**

  
  

* **8+ years** of relevant experience in data engineering, application development, database development, or related technology roles.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python and PySpark for large-scale data processing and ETL development.
* Strong proficiency in SQL/T-SQL and relational database technologies, preferably Microsoft SQL Server.
* Experience developing and supporting complex SQL queries, stored procedures, database objects, and high-volume data-processing solutions.
* Strong understanding of SQL Server performance tuning, including query execution plans, indexing, statistics, joins, locking/blocking, and query optimization.
* Experience with Microsoft BI/SSIS or comparable enterprise ETL technologies.
* Experience working with large datasets and distributed data platforms such as Hadoop/HDFS/Hive.
* Strong understanding of ETL architecture, data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and relational/3NF modeling.

title: Lead Platform Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Lead Platform EngineerLead Platform Engineer (Database, Cloud & DevOps)  
Overview  
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible.  
The Database & Platform Engineering team is responsible for building and operating secure, scalable, highly available, and automated database platforms that support Mastercard's mission-critical payment systems. We are seeking a Lead Platform Engineer to drive the engineering, automation, reliability, and operational excellence of Oracle and PostgreSQL platforms across on-premises and AWS cloud environments.  
This role combines deep database expertise, cloud engineering, DevOps automation, and technical leadership to deliver resilient platforms that enable Mastercard's next generation of payment solutions.  
  
Role  
As a Lead Platform Engineer, you will:  
Lead the design, build, automation, and support of Oracle and PostgreSQL database platforms.  
Engineer highly available and resilient solutions using Oracle RAC, Data Guard, GoldenGate, PostgreSQL Replication, and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL.  
Drive AWS cloud adoption and modernization initiatives across database and infrastructure platforms.  
Develop Infrastructure-as-Code and automation solutions to improve provisioning, deployment, patching, monitoring, and recovery processes.  
Implement and enhance CI/CD pipelines to accelerate delivery while maintaining security and compliance.  
Partner with Software Engineering, SRE, Security, and Product teams to deliver reliable and scalable services.  
Lead performance optimization, capacity planning, observability, disaster recovery, and operational excellence initiatives.  
Provide technical leadership during major incidents, root cause analysis, and platform improvement activities.  
Mentor engineers and champion engineering best practices, automation, and continuous improvement.  
All About You  
Extensive hands-on experience with Oracle Database administration and engineering, including RAC, ASM, RMAN, Data Guard, and GoldenGate.  
Strong expertise in PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, including performance tuning, replication, backup, recovery, and high availability.  
Experience designing and supporting large-scale production platforms in AWS, including Aurora, RDS, EC2, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and S3.  
Strong DevOps and automation experience using Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or similar technologies.  
Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Shell, Bash, or PowerShell.  
Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions such as OEM, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, or CloudWatch.  
Strong understanding of database security, operational resilience, disaster recovery, and compliance requirements.  
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.  
Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on technical execution in a fast-paced environment.  
Preferred Qualifications  
Experience within financial services, payments, or other high-volume transaction processing environments.  
Knowledge of Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, and cloud-native platform technologies.  
Experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and platform modernization initiatives.  
AWS, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or related cloud certifications.  
Experience driving automation, self-service platforms, and AI-assisted operational capabilities.  
  
Corporate Security Responsibility  
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks come with an inherent risk to the organization. Every person working for or on behalf of Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:  
Abide by Mastercard security policies and practices.  
Protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information.  
Report security incidents, vulnerabilities, or policy violations.  
Complete all required security and compliance training.  
This position offers the opportunity to shape the future of Mastercard's database and cloud platforms while driving innovation, automation, and operational excellence at global scale.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – eApps
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

• Lead the engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure supporting third-party Enterprise Applications (E-Apps), with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary cloud environment.

• Own hands-on infrastructure engineering across cloud and hybrid environments, including secure design, provisioning, migration, deployment, capacity, reliability, and lifecycle management.

• Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform as the primary tool, supported by Ansible, Python, and Shell scripting; use PowerShell where required for Windows administration.

• Partner with solution teams, Enterprise Applications stakeholders, security, network, and service teams to define hosting standards, technical specifications, operational readiness, and support models.

• Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and promote standardization, observability, ITSM discipline, and secure-by-design practices across the E-Apps platform.

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

• **Operate and continuously improve** the E-Apps infrastructure estate, including availability, performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.

• **Design and provision GCP infrastructure** using approved architecture and security patterns across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, certificates, logging, monitoring, storage, and secrets management.

• **Build reusable Terraform modules and deployment patterns** and develop Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell scripts to eliminate manual work and improve deployment consistency.

• **Administer and troubleshoot web and application platforms** including IIS, JBoss, and Apache, with understanding of Java application hosting, reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS offload, certificates, ports, and application integrations.

• **Implement observability and operational insight** using Datadog and GCP monitoring/logging capabilities, including dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, alerting, health checks, service-level indicators, and actionable runbooks.

• **Apply ITSM practices** across incident, problem, change, service request, knowledge, and major-incident management; maintain accurate operational documentation and participate in governance and change reviews.

• **Act as a senior escalation point** for outages, complex incidents, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, security findings, and recovery activities; drive permanent corrective actions.

• **Establish standards and governance** for configuration, access, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness of new and existing applications.

• **Mentor team members and coordinate support coverage** while promoting knowledge sharing, effective handoffs, and continuous improvement across the platform team.

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

• **Education:** Full-time bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.

• **Experience:** 8–12 years of experience designing, implementing, operating, and supporting complex infrastructure and enterprise application environments, including high-availability and mission-critical systems.

• **GCP — primary requirement:** Strong hands-on experience with GCP services and architecture, including Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, SSL certificates, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Secret Manager, storage, and hybrid connectivity.

• **Terraform — primary engineering keyword:** Demonstrated experience creating maintainable Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, environment configuration, state management, policy controls, and automated provisioning at scale.

• **Scripting and automation:** Strong Shell scripting and Python experience for operational tooling, integrations, validations, remediation, and workflow automation; practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and application/platform automation.

• **Web and application infrastructure:** Hands-on understanding of IIS, JBoss, and Apache administration, configuration, troubleshooting, patching, reverse proxying, Java application hosting, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, and integration with enterprise applications.

• **Observability:** Good hands-on experience with Datadog and/or equivalent observability platforms, covering monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, synthetic or endpoint checks, and incident correlation.

• **ITSM and operations:** Working knowledge of ITSM practices and operational controls, including incident, problem, change, service request, major-incident, SLA, knowledge-management, and root-cause-analysis processes.

• **Systems and troubleshooting:** Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server, networking fundamentals, firewalls, DNS, identity/access, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL, and vendor-supported enterprise applications.

• **Leadership:** Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

• **Cloud breadth:** Working knowledge of AWS and Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud requirement for the role.

• **Delivery practices:** Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, DevOps practices, and secure software delivery.

• **Platform experience:** Experience supporting SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, vendor-built applications, cloud migrations, and hybrid enterprise environments.

• **Certifications:** GCP, Terraform, Ansible, ITIL, or other relevant cloud and infrastructure certifications are desirable.

• **Continuous improvement:** Ability to use AI capabilities where they deliver business value and improve support, operations, and user productivity.

• **Leadership behaviors:** Demonstrates ownership, initiative, integrity, constructive challenge, collaboration, and an engaging leadership style; develops people and drives initiatives from idea through execution.

  

**SUPPORT REQUIREMENT**

• The role requires extended off-hours coverage, including overnight, weekend, and holiday on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs and the team’s operational support model.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Head of Operations
description:
**The Role**

We're hiring a Head of Operations to run Adzzat day to day. Today our COO does it himself. Your job is to take it off his plate and run it better. Adzzat is the delivery layer behind AI data companies. They bring the project. We bring vetted engineers, finance experts and annotators from across India, and we run everything else: vetting, onboarding, quality, project management and payouts. Our promise to clients is simple: you get the output, we handle the ops. We're growing fast, and you're the person who keeps that promise as we do.

**What a week looks like**

No two weeks are the same. A typical one, compressed:

**Monday:** A client sends a new project: 200 expert tasks in 10 days, in a skill we've never staffed. By Wednesday you've scoped it, tested the first 20 people and shipped a pilot batch.

**Tuesday:** A batch comes back with too many rejections. By evening you know why. By morning the guidelines are fixed and the team is retrained.

**Wednesday:** A prospect wants samples by Friday to decide on a pilot. They get them Thursday.

**Thursday:** Your best reviewer is out mid-deadline. Nothing slips, because you never let one person become the bottleneck.

**Friday:** Payout day. Hundreds of tasks across projects and pay tiers. Everyone is paid on time and the numbers match the invoice.

In between: client calls, contributor escalations, and at least one problem nobody has seen before.

**You're measured on:**

* On-time delivery
* First-pass acceptance (work the client accepts without rework)
* Days from kickoff to first accepted batch
* Payouts on time and accurate
* Retention of top contributors
* Founder hours spent in ops (target: close to zero)

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

title: Chief Engineer
description:
**Role summary**

The Chief Engineer owns the delivery of all our projects on cost, time, quality and safety, and builds the engineering department that does it. He heads a team of about 49 people across three current projects worth ₹450 cr in construction cost and ₹1,024 cr in revenue. With new projects starting, the department will handle ₹500–600 cr of construction in the next 12 months, and the team will grow with it.

Key responsibilities

**1. Budgeting, estimation and cost control**

* Prepare a complete project budget from start to handover: BOQ for every item, rate analysis, and material and labour costs.
* Own quantity surveying: quantity takeoffs, measurement as per IS 1200, and payment certification.
* Run cost control against budget every month, with variance explained item by item.
* Drive value engineering without reducing quality or customer value.
* Maintain an internal rate database for materials, labour and subcontracts, updated every quarter.
* Run material reconciliation (steel, cement, RMC, blocks, aluform) with agreed wastage limits.

**2. Tendering, procurement and contracts**

* Run tenders: scope, BOQ, comparative statements and negotiation.
* Set up rate contracts for repetitive items and an approved vendor list of at least 3 vendors per category.
* Link the procurement schedule to the construction programme so material arrives before it is needed.
* Administer contracts: variations, extensions of time, claims, final accounts and contractor closures.
* Support the company in disputes and arbitration with records and analysis.

**3. Planning and site execution**

* Prepare the master programme for each project, with S-curves for progress and cash flow.
* Plan site logistics: where material is stored, where steel is loaded, crane and hoist positions, and where construction starts, in line with Vastu guidance where the company applies it.
* Manage the aluform cycle: slab cycle time, repetitions, shuttering inventory and wastage.
* Manage plant and machinery: utilisation, and rent-versus-buy decisions.
* Oversee temporary works, excavation support and the interpretation of soil reports.

**4. Design coordination**

* Review architectural, structural and MEP drawings and resolve clashes before they reach site.
* Run the drawing release schedule and RFI process with consultants.
* Guide the project coordinators who handle design coordination alongside compliance.

**5. Quality and safety**

* Set up the QA/QC system: inspection test plans, mix designs, cube registers, NABL lab testing and third-party audits.
* Apply ISO-style documentation and SOPs across all quality processes.
* Own site safety: statutory compliance, safety audits, toolbox talks and incident reporting.

**6. Regulatory and statutory compliance**

* MahaRERA: the engineer's certificate (Form 2) for escrow withdrawals and quarterly progress updates.
* Labour: BOCW registration, labour cess, contractor licences and checks that contractors pay PF and ESIC.
* Environmental: EC conditions, MPCB consents, STP and rainwater harvesting.
* Authority approvals with PMC/PCMC, together with the liaison and compliance team.

**7. Handover and after-sales**

* Snagging, handover to buyers, and the defect liability system for the 5-year RERA period.
* Handover to facility management: as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties and AMCs.
* Coordinate with sales and CRM on customisation requests, sample flats and possession dates.

**8. Team, systems and technology**

* Build, hire and lead the department (team structure below).
* Write and enforce SOPs for every repeated process, and keep documentation complete.
* Train and upskill existing staff, including the current billing manager.
* Drive ERP discipline, digital site reporting, and the use of AI tools and new roles in the department.
* Run a lessons-learned review at the end of each project.

**9. Reporting to management**

* A monthly MIS report to the Managing Director: progress, cost, cash flow, quality, safety and top risks.
* A risk register for each project, with an owner and mitigation for each risk.

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
**SOVOS**

**Salesforce Application Architect**
====================================

Accounting/Finance·Full-Time·India

**Build Your Future With Us**

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

**THE ROLE**

At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. This is a senior technical leadership role where you'll balance deep platform engineering, CPQ expertise, and modern AI tooling to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at global scale. Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes - apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

*More specifically, you will:*

* Own the Salesforce technical architecture across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, designing scalable, maintainable solutions that balance declarative and programmatic approaches with a strong focus on long-term platform health and org simplicity.
* Govern platform engineering standards for Apex, LWC, SFDX, and Flow automation, including coding standards, architecture and code reviews, bulkification patterns, metadata hygiene, and technical debt remediation to keep the platform performant as it scales.
* Design and maintain the Salesforce security model including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, permission sets, permission set groups, field-level security, and sharing rules; conduct periodic security audits and enforce least-privilege access.
* Architect and engineer the Salesforce CPQ platform, including product catalogue, pricing rules, QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), Advanced Approvals, amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation; own end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process integrity and integrations with Zuora and NetSuite via middleware.
* Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features directly on the Salesforce platform using LLM APIs (Claude, Copilot), including agentic data-quality workflows, deal and quoting chatbots grounded in CPQ data, and AI-assisted development workflows; evaluate and govern Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce agents, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder.
* Architect and govern Salesforce integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials, and External Services; set clear standards for declarative versus programmatic callout patterns and partner with data and integrations teams on middleware strategy.
* Lead Salesforce DevOps practices using Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines; govern platform health via Salesforce Health Check, Code Analyser in the CI pipeline, and org limits monitoring; enforce sandbox strategy, environment governance, and AppExchange package evaluation.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for the Salesforce team; conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor administrators and developers, and partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into sound technical design, communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Lead Salesforce workstreams for M&A due diligence and post-close integration; own platform controls aligned to SOX ITGC requirements including change management controls, access review evidence, and audit log configuration.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**

* You've built deep platform expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Service Cloud, and integrations in a global SaaS environment, with solid architecture and engineering skills demonstrated over the course of your career.
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect required; Certified Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect strongly preferred; strong data architecture skills including large data volume (LDV) management (skinny tables, custom indexes, archiving), SOQL query optimisation, and data migration design.
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist required or equivalent experience; deep hands-on experience with QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation across upsell, cross-sell, churn, migration, and recontracting scenarios.
* Demonstrated experience building AI/LLM integrations directly on the Salesforce platform using Claude API, Gemini API, or equivalent, including agentic workflows and AI-powered automation in production CRM environments; familiarity with Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, Prompt Builder, and Einstein Trust Layer.
* Strong Apex, LWC, and Flow development expertise; ability to set and enforce coding standards, perform code reviews, design complex Flow automation (screen flows, Flow Orchestration), and govern the declarative automation layer at scale.
* Experience with Salesforce integration architecture including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, External Services, and middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft); Zuora and NetSuite integration experience a strong plus; proficiency with Salesforce DevOps (SFDX, CI/CD, Copado, Prodly, or Gearset) and platform governance.
* Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and leveraging AI tools to improve platform architecture, engineering quality, and delivery speed; strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone executive stakeholder engagement.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

**THE PROCESS**

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

**Pre-Employment Assessment**

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

**LIFE AT SOVOS**

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

**Our values:**

  

* **Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.**
* **Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.**
* **Strive: We are driven and determined.**
* **Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.**
* **Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.**
  

**What we need:**

  

The MCIM Engineer is accountable for country and site-level administration, data integrity, workflow compliance and operational adoption of the Mission Critical Infrastructure Management platform across assigned data center facilities. Reporting directly to the in-country Manager, Operations Support, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the platform Director, MCIM and Asset Management, the role ensures critical assets, maintenance activities, incidents, operational changes, corrective actions and supporting evidence are accurately managed through MCIM as the authoritative operational system of record.

  

The role acts as the primary interface between Facility Operations and the central MCIM Platform team, translating platform standards, asset taxonomies, workflows and governance requirements into disciplined country and site-level execution. The MCIM Engineer supports users, monitors compliance, validates operational data, coordinates system improvements and ensures activities undertaken by employees, contractors and service providers are complete, traceable and audit-ready.

  

The Director, MCIM and Asset Management owns platform strategy, system standards, core workflow design, configuration governance, asset taxonomy and cross-country standardization. The in-country Manager, Operations Support owns local leadership, prioritization and integration of MCIM requirements into country operations. Facility Operations remains accountable for the safe and correct execution of operational work. The MCIM Engineer does not replace these accountabilities but ensures the work is properly planned, controlled, recorded and evidenced through the platform.

  

**Key responsibilities:**

  

* Own country and site-level MCIM administration, adoption, data integrity and workflow compliance across assigned data center facilities, ensuring the platform is consistently used for applicable asset, maintenance, incident, change, corrective-action and operational activities.
* Maintain complete and accurate critical infrastructure asset records, including asset classifications, hierarchies, technical attributes, equipment relationships, dependencies, maintenance requirements, lifecycle status and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate asset-data preparation, validation, migration and reconciliation during new facility delivery, commissioning, operational readiness, expansion, retrofit, equipment replacement and decommissioning activities.
* Administer preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance workflows within MCIM, ensuring work orders are properly planned, authorized, assigned, executed, evidenced, reviewed and closed in accordance with approved maintenance strategies and operating requirements.
* Govern site-level incident, root cause and corrective-action records, ensuring events are correctly classified, escalated and linked to affected assets, with complete evidence and timely investigation, verification and closure of corrective and preventive actions.
* Administer operational change workflows, verifying that changes include the required scope, risk assessment, technical and operational review, authorization, implementation planning, asset linkage, communications, execution evidence and post-implementation validation.
* Monitor data quality and workflow performance, identifying incomplete records, untracked activities, duplicated data, configuration inconsistencies, control gaps and deviations from approved platform standards, and coordinating timely corrective action.
* Support MCIM implementation, configuration, enhancement, upgrade, integration, pilot and user acceptance testing activities, documenting operational requirements and validating that workflows and system outputs are effective for live data center operations.
* Develop operational dashboards and recurring reports, provide user training and first-line process support, and support internal and customer audits through accurate records, traceable workflows, complete evidence and timely remediation of identified gaps.
  

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

  

**The successful candidate:**

  

* Relevant experience in data center operations, critical facilities, infrastructure asset management, maintenance planning, operational systems administration or a comparable mission-critical or high-availability environment.
* Relevant degree, diploma or professional qualification in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, building services engineering, facilities management, information systems, asset management or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Practical experience using or administering CMMS, DCIM, EAM, work-order management, asset-management, maintenance-management or comparable operational platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of asset lifecycle management, preventive and corrective maintenance, incident management, change control, operational risk assessment, corrective-action management and audit evidence requirements.
* Demonstrated experience maintaining accurate asset and operational data, resolving data-quality issues and record inconsistencies, and producing reliable operational reports and dashboards.
* Experience supporting system implementation, workflow configuration, data migration, platform enhancement, user acceptance testing or the integration of operational technology and enterprise systems.
* Sound understanding of data center critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical, controls, monitoring, life-safety and associated building systems.
* Proven ability to work across Facility Operations, Engineering Operations, digital platform teams, project teams, contractors, vendors and service providers, supported by strong analytical, organizational, documentation and problem-solving capability.
* Must have strong English-language verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to deliver user training, prepare high-quality operational reports, communicate compliance requirements and engage technical and senior stakeholders; familiarity with applicable asset management, quality, information security, business continuity, safety, environmental and ISO management systems is advantageous.
  

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.
