title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers — we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments.

We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability,and adoption across the firm.

Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems.

As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation.

**What the team owns**

* Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor
* Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform
* CI/CD platforms, reusable pipelines and release automation
* SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models
* Self-service capabilities, internal APIs and integrations that remove manual toil from engineering teams
* Developer experience measurement, adoption and the services we provide to engineering teams across MSCI

Your Key Responsibilities:

* Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI — simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases.
* Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform.
* Run the developer tooling estate as a product: monitor health and usage, resolve issues, manage upgrades and configuration, and improve the reliability of services engineers depend on daily.
* Apply proactive problem solving to developer pain points — find friction in engineering workflows before it is escalated, trace issues to root cause, and deliver durable fixes rather than workarounds.
* Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers.
* Contribute to SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices, translating agreed standards into working automation, templates, and controls.
* Partner with Security, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Risk, and Application Engineering teams to embed governance, compliance, and operational controls directly into engineering workflows and platform capabilities.
* Treat engineering teams as customers: gather feedback, document and support what you build.

Required

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Hands on Programming experience in Go or Java.
* Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, or related software engineering roles.
* Software engineering mindset, with hands-on experience building automation, APIs, internal tooling, or reusable workflows that other engineers depend on.
* Solid working experience with SCM and CI/CD tooling such as GitHub (preferred), Azure DevOps, and/or GitLab, including repositories, pipelines, reusable workflows and templates, permissions, and integrations.
* Good understanding of the SDLC and software delivery workflows, including source control governance, branching strategies, release processes, and developer enablement practices.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and webhooks.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Operational mindset, with experience supporting tooling or services that other teams rely on in production.
* Intellectual curiosity and critical thinking — willingness to dig into unfamiliar problems, question how things work today, and evidence a better way.

* Exposure to an internal developer platform or portal (Backstage or equivalent).
* Experience building self-service engineering workflows or developer enablement tooling.
* Experience with platform observability, engineering metrics, or developer productivity initiatives.
* Exposure to GitOps frameworks.

description:
**Manager Software Engineering**

  

**Are you passionate about leading engineering teams that build high-volume production systems using modern technologies?**

  

**Would you like to combine Java, Springboot and GEN AI experience with technical leadership in the healthcare space?**

  

**About the Business**

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Healthcare vertical, our solutions focus on transforming operations and improving health outcomes across the healthcare industry. While our solutions are centered around robust data assets, we also leverage sophisticated technology, applied analytics and deep healthcare expertise while ensuring the highest standards of privacy and security to help healthcare organizations make confident decisions and solve complex challenges. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/healthcare .

  

**About the Team**

We organize our engineering teams into collaborative Squads that bring together Software Engineers, Quality Engineers, Product Managers, and Engineering Leaders to build and deliver customer-focused solutions.

Our teams value continuous learning, innovation, inclusivity, and shared ownership. We encourage engineers to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, mentor others, and help shape the future of our products and platforms.

  

**About the Role**

You will lead and develop an engineering team delivering production systems and high-volume applications, while remaining close enough to the technology to contribute when needed. You will work across Engineering, Product, and Design, helping the team deliver commitments, solve complex technical challenges, and build expertise in Java, Springboot and GEN AI.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Empower, guide, and maximize a team of mission-driven engineers to solve challenging problems in the aviation industry by building using cutting-edge technology.
* Collaborate with Engineering leadership and cross-functional partners (including Product, Design, Marketing) to establish roadmaps and strategy that help serve and grow the business and represent engineering-driven considerations to ensure all stakeholder groups are aligned on company priorities, expectations, and contingencies.
* Contribute to technical development and discussions as necessary to ensure the team is building technology that scales and meets the business needs by Providing both ongoing support and mentorship to direct reports, strategically aligning their skills, interests, and career aspirations with business needs; defining, streamlining, and guiding the projects they work on; and both initiating and inviting conversations around performance, development, and morale
* Deliver results in the fast-paced environment of a growing startup while always treating team members and colleagues with empathy & humanity
* Successfully partner and lead resources in solving complex business needs. Perform reviews to ensure enterprise and architectural standards and processes are followed. Complete management responsibilities to include performance management, hiring and coaching of staff, and resource planning.
* Carry out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies, procedures, and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; and addressing complaints and resolving problems.
* Ensure all staff is provided with training and resources needed to perform their jobs to the most outstanding degree possible. Ensure all staff is provided with frequent feedback and coaching in order to meet and exceed individual and team performance goals consistently.

* Experience with technologies mainly focused on Java and Springboot background in addition to GEN AI exposure.

title: D&T Manager – Sites & Services
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  
  

**OVERVIEW**

This senior role is a strategic engineering leader within the BTFE team, responsible for architecting, building, and overseeing scalable, secure, and maintainable digital products and services. The individual will lead delivery across the predominantly .NET-based BTFE technology ecosystem, while governing mobile application delivery through vendor partners and strengthening the team’s future cross-platform engineering capabilities.

With advanced expertise across multiple technologies, they will guide full lifecycle development—from technical planning and design to implementation, deployment, and ongoing optimization. They will mentor developers, lead design discussions, manage technical risks and debt, and collaborate cross-functionally to align solutions with business objectives. The role also includes ownership of production stability, vendor engineering quality, troubleshooting, performance tuning, security, and sustained technical excellence across web, API, backend, and mobile-integrated platforms.

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**Delivery Leadership & Execution**

* Leading delivery of complex BTFE products, platforms, and modules across internal teams and vendor partners with end-to-end accountability for scope, quality, release readiness, and delivery outcomes

* Owning production support strategy across BTFE platforms, including incident management, root cause analysis, problem management, service reliability, and continuous improvement for critical issues

* Driving stakeholder alignment through active participation in product discovery, requirement gathering, scope definition, technical planning, dependency management, and release planning

* Providing high-confidence estimates for large-scale efforts, advising on resourcing and partner capacity, and establishing delivery plans that balance near-term outcomes with long-term technical health

**Learning, Development & Mentoring**

* Championing a culture of continuous learning, introducing relevant emerging technologies, cross-platform frameworks, engineering practices, and AI-enabled ways of working

* Providing deep mentorship and technical guidance to mid- and junior-level engineers, while building capability across .NET, web/API, cloud, integration, and mobile engineering fundamentals

* Leading internal initiatives such as architecture reviews, engineering talks, vendor knowledge exchanges, and capability development programs

* Demonstrating strong leadership presence, strengthening team culture and practices, and creating an environment where people can do their best work and grow

**Technical Consulting & Strategy**

* Creating and validating high-level estimations, technology roadmaps, modernization plans, and investment cases for large, cross-functional BTFE efforts

* Designing and owning complex, scalable, secure, and resilient end-to-end solutions across .NET, APIs, cloud services, data stores, third-party integrations, and mobile experiences

Serving as an advisor across BTFE product, business, operations, security, architecture, and vendor communities, aligning solutions with strategic goals and user needs.  

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Independently defines and manages work plans for complex projects, driving alignment across teams and contributing to strategic project planning

* Has led multiple medium-to-large projects or delivered key enterprise-level components with full accountability for scope, quality, delivery outcomes, and production readiness

* Shapes and enforces IT technical standards, driving adoption of best practices and fostering engineering excellence across teams, vendors, and initiatives

* Possesses expert-level knowledge of enterprise architecture, system design patterns, distributed systems, and technical toolsets, applying them to architect resilient, scalable solutions

* Advanced experience with .NET Core, C#, ASP.NET Core/Web API, API integration, relational and NoSQL databases, cloud platforms, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and production support

Credible cross-platform development experience with exposure to mobile application engineering, including mobile architecture, API integration, security, performance, telemetry, release lifecycle, and app-store delivery; hands-on experience with React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, .NET MAUI, or equivalent is expected.  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Demonstrates the General Mills leadership behaviors required for success: energizes and inspires others; grows by deepening and sharing expertise; challenges with strategic courage; delivers impactful results across teams; and connects and aligns cross-functional efforts

* Experience with .NET MAUI, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, or comparable cross-platform frameworks, with working knowledge of native iOS and/or Android engineering ecosystems

* Energizes and inspires others

* Grows by deepening and sharing expertise

* Challenges with strategic courage

* Delivers impactful results across teams

* Connects and aligns cross-functional efforts

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Sr Manager Client Technology
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are hiring a Manager, Cloud Platform Engineers to lead our India-based platform and automation engineering staff. This is a people-management role with real technical ownership - you will be evaluated as much on your ability to review and stand behind your team's Kubernetes and Terraform work as on how you manage the people producing it. You will oversee day-to-day execution of AKS operations and Terraform-based automation, working in close coordination with the US-based Principal and Expert Platform Engineers who set the platform's architectural direction.

This role exists to provide direct, hands-on management and accurate technical oversight of the India-based team - including work planning, prioritization, quality review, and status reporting to the Senior Manager, Cloud Platform. Reporting must reflect verified, actual system state; this is a core expectation of the role, not a formality.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

· Directly manage India-based Cloud Platform engineers, including workload assignment, prioritization, and day-to-day people management.

· Review and stand behind your team's Terraform module submissions and AKS configuration changes for correctness, adherence to documented standards, and production-readiness before they are considered complete.

· Enforce engineering process standards across the team: issue-based work tracking, triage and prioritization before work begins, work-in-progress limits, and daily status updates.

· Provide the Senior Manager, Cloud Platform with accurate, verified status reporting on the India-based team's work - cross-checked against actual system and repository state, not summarized from memory or secondhand updates.

· Coordinate with the Principal and Expert Platform Engineers on platform architecture and standards, ensuring the India-based team's work aligns with the broader platform's GitOps, Terraform, and AKS conventions.

· Escalate technical or delivery risks early and directly, rather than allowing status to be discovered after the fact.

· Support hiring, onboarding, and skill development for the India-based team, including closing gaps in Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD fundamentals where needed.

· Apply policy-as-code and security standards already established on the platform (Kyverno or equivalent) when reviewing team output.

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

· 5+ years in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering roles, including some prior people-management or formal technical-lead experience.

· Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes, ideally AKS specifically - sufficient to personally review a team member's cluster or workload change and identify problems.

· Working Terraform experience, including the ability to review a submitted module for correctness, reusability, and adherence to documented standards.

· GitOps experience (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent) - all infrastructure and cluster changes should trace to a git commit as a matter of practice, not preference.

· Demonstrated ability to produce accurate, verifiable status reporting to senior leadership.

· Experience managing engineers directly, including performance management, prioritization, and workload planning.

· Working fluency in policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent).

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

· Experience managing a distributed or offshore engineering team reporting to a manager in a different region.

· Practical, current experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work.

· Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent).

· Background modernizing legacy automation (PowerShell or similar) toward Terraform or platform-native replacements.

title: Tools Development Engineer

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Very organized, proactive, and has good learning ability.
The ability to work with a team of engineers in a fast-paced environment  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Good problem-solving skills (solid logic to apply in isolation and regression of issues found) and good written communications skills
* Substantial experience with AI-driven automation
* Ability to work in a distributed team environment
* Development experience capable of fixing regression bugs , implementing/enabling test for CI/CD

title: Manager - QA
description:
### **Description**

Davies is looking for an experienced Manager - Software Quality Assurance (QA) to lead the quality engineering function and ensure reliable, secure, and high-quality software delivery across products and platforms. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Development, this role will be accountable for QA strategy, people leadership, test governance, automation direction, release readiness, quality metrics, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will combine strong quality engineering expertise with the ability to lead teams, influence delivery stakeholders, manage risks, and embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define and own the QA strategy, operating model, standards, processes, and roadmap across software delivery teams.
* Lead, coach, and develop QA engineers, including objective setting, regular feedback, capability development, workload planning, and performance support.
* Establish risk-based test strategies covering functional, regression, integration, data validation, API, performance, security, accessibility, and user acceptance testing, as applicable.
* Own test planning, estimation, resourcing, prioritization, and execution across multiple projects, releases, and delivery teams.
* Drive the test automation strategy, framework governance, tool selection, coverage improvement, maintainability, and integration into CI/CD pipelines.
* Partner with product, engineering, architecture, business, and delivery leaders to define acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, quality gates, and release readiness.
* Provide clear go/no-go recommendations based on test evidence, defect risk, business impact, and agreed quality thresholds.
* Define, monitor, and report quality metrics such as defect leakage, automation coverage, test effectiveness, execution progress, escaped defects, and release risk.
* Oversee defect triage and ensure defects are clearly documented, prioritized, resolved, retested, and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
* Champion shift-left quality practices, including early QA involvement, requirements reviews, testability reviews, developer testing, and continuous validation.
* Ensure test environments, test data, tools, and dependencies are planned and available to support predictable delivery.
* Identify quality, delivery, and operational risks early; agree mitigation plans and escalate material risks appropriately.
* Continuously improve QA efficiency through automation, reusable assets, better engineering practices, and appropriate use of AI-assisted testing capabilities.
* Manage QA suppliers or partners where applicable, ensuring delivery quality, transparency, and alignment with Davies standards.
* Build a strong quality engineering community of practice and promote consistent standards, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
* Support audits, regulatory expectations, and governance requirements by maintaining appropriate test evidence, traceability, and documentation.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of software quality assurance or quality engineering experience, including significant test automation experience.
* 3+ years of experience leading QA engineers or managing quality delivery across multiple teams or workstreams.
* Experience delivering quality assurance for web applications, APIs, integrations, data platforms, or enterprise systems
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating with distributed, cross-functional teams.

  

### **About Davies**

We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  
  
We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation & risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation & change management.  
  
Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK & the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20-fold, investing heavily in research & development, innovation & automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: Senior Engineer, Platform Engineering
description:
**About Cencora**
-----------------

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

**Job Details**
===============

  

Cencora is a leading global pharmaceutical distribution and healthcare solutions organization dedicated to improving the lives of people and animals worldwide. Through its extensive network of manufacturers, healthcare providers, pharmacies, and patients, Cencora helps ensure timely and reliable access to critical therapies and healthcare services. The company continually invests in innovative technologies, operational excellence, and talented professionals to advance healthcare delivery and create meaningful impact across the global healthcare ecosystem.

**Summary:**

The Senior Platform Engineer for Leena AI is a senior individual contributor within the Platform Engineering organization, responsible for owning and operating Cencora's Leena AI deployment — an agentic AI platform used to automate HR, IT, and employee support workflows at enterprise scale. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role applies deep technical expertise to extend Leena AI's capabilities by connecting it to internal systems via custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, alongside platform configuration, integration engineering, and operational monitoring responsibilities.

**Platform Administration**
---------------------------

* Configure and maintain the Leena AI instance, including Knowledge Studio content sources, permissions and access controls, and governance policies.
* Build and optimize agentic workflows using AOP Studio and Workflow Studio, translating HR and IT business requirements into automated AI Colleague processes.
* Own the Leena AI platform roadmap, proactively identifying opportunities to expand automation coverage and enhance employee experience.

**MCP & Integration Engineering (Core Focus)**

* Design, implement, and maintain Custom MCP Connectors to register internal MCP servers with Leena AI, enabling internal tools and data sources to be surfaced as agent actions.

* Perform OAuth client registration, redirect URI setup, and credential management where required.
* Validate and troubleshoot tool discovery and runtime schema synchronization across connected MCP servers as services evolve.
* Assess and implement pre-built MCP connectors and the Pipedream MCP Connector where appropriate, making informed build-versus-buy decisions.
* Coordinate network connectivity, infrastructure requirements, and security reviews for internally hosted MCP servers in partnership with enterprise infrastructure and security teams.

title: QA Tech Lead
description:
**WHY XOGENE?**

At Xogene, we’re revolutionizing the future of clinical trial transparency through AI-powered solutions. Join our team of experts who are transforming how leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies navigate regulatory compliance. If you're driven by solving complex problems in a professional environment focused on meaningful and rewarding work, we want to hear from you.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Xogene combines regulatory expertise with advanced technology to automate complex processes in clinical trial transparency. Our software streamlines workflows through AI and agentic networking capabilities, improving data transformation and regulatory compliance for leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies. We're committed to advancing technological solutions in clinical trial transparency.

As we continue to expand, we are seeking an experienced QA Tech Lead to drive our test automation initiatives and strengthen our testing strategy. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the QA Tech Lead will own test automation strategy and execution.

This is a hands-on technical role: you will write and maintain automated tests while guiding the team's automation direction.

**KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead and mentor automation engineers, provide technical guidance to the wider testing team, and foster a culture of quality excellence and continuous improvement.
* Support skill development across the team, including cross-training manual testers in automation (e.g., Playwright Codegen, low-code contributions, and AI-assisted scripting with tools such as Claude) and ensuring automation engineers understand product domain and end-user workflows.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Development, Customer Success, Product Management, Design and Product Support across multiple time zones.
* Define the overall risk-based test strategy, focusing testing effort where regulatory and customer risk is highest, with clear criteria for which tests are automated, which remain manual, and what doesn't need a test at all. Own automation test plans and standards across all Xogene product releases.
* Create and maintain quality metrics, KPIs, and dashboards on testing progress and potential blockers, and provide regular updates to the Director of Engineering.
* Define test scope, objectives, success criteria, and time and resource estimates with stakeholders, and ensure comprehensive coverage through effective test case design and review.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate quality risks throughout each sprint cycle, including during pre-release dry runs.
* Architect, build, and maintain scalable automation testing frameworks, including our custom-built Playwright framework, enforcing code standards, and maximizing test reusability through the Page Object Model (POM).
* Develop and execute automated test scenarios, scripts, and procedures for system, integration, regression, and API testing, growing automated test coverage across all Xogene software products.
* Act as the technical point of contact and subject matter expert on the code and system architecture, diagnosing complex technical problems and designing solutions that reflect lessons learned.
* Identify manual test cases suitable for automation and work with the Test Lead to prioritize and transition them.
* Move automated suites from manual triggers to a tiered CI/CD strategy in GitHub Actions (Smoke, Sanity, and Nightly Regression) that serves as quality gates for developers, and maintain suite health, including resolving flaky tests and tracking automation coverage.
* Oversee the integration between Playwright and Zephyr Scale, reporting test results directly into Zephyr Scale through automated JUnit XML reporting pipelines and maintaining a single source of truth for QA metrics.
* Oversee test environments and test data management, ensuring realistic, compliant test data is available for both manual and automated testing.
* Perform manual testing where automation is impractical, defect triage and resolution, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), contributing automated regression coverage where practical.
* Contribute automation coverage and results to validation documentation, including the Test Plan, Test Summary Report, Traceability Matrix, and UAT Scripts.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Minimum 7 years of experience in software testing or QA engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical or automation lead role
* Hands-on experience testing large-scale enterprise SaaS web applications and complex software systems, including role-based access controls (RBAC), multi-tenant data isolation, and API integration layers
* Experience leading automation engineers and working closely with manual testers
* Solid understanding of manual testing, including test case design techniques (e.g., boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning), exploratory testing, and regression planning
* Ability to assess automation ROI and recommend the right balance of manual and automated testing effort based on risk, release cadence, and product maturity
* Expert-level proficiency in Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript or Python), including building frameworks from the ground up using design patterns such as the Page Object Model (POM), plus experience with other automation tools (e.g., Selenium, REST Assured)
* Strong hands-on programming skills (TypeScript, Python, JavaScript) and working knowledge of database technologies
* Proficiency in performance testing tools (JMeter, LoadRunner) and API testing frameworks
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and test integration strategies
* Expertise in the SDLC and test management tools (e.g., Jira, Zephyr Scale), including hands-on experience automating test execution uploads to Zephyr Scale via APIs
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical team members

**DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Ability to balance long-term automation architecture with immediate release needs

* Team leadership skills, including delegating and prioritizing work, giving constructive feedback, and supporting the growth of team members
* Commitment to staying current with industry trends and emerging testing technologies
* Experience working in fast-paced, innovative technology environments
* Experience in collaborative, agile teams that regularly deploy high-quality software to production
* Strong business acumen and understanding of how quality impacts customer success and business outcomes
* Experience testing in regulated environments (e.g., GxP, computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11)
* Experience testing AI/LLM-powered features, including strategies for validating non-deterministic outputs
* Experience configuring AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude) to accelerate QA scripting workflows
* Background in lightweight DevOps tasks, such as Docker and managing staging/test environments

title: D&T Analyst II – Data Stewardship
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The Digital and Technology team of General Mills India Centre is looking for a passionate and enthusiastic individual to contribute to the Global Digital Transformation initiative at General Mills in capacity of a D&T Analyst II – Data Stewardship. This role will report into Sr. D&T Manager - Data Stewardship, GDGS team in India and functionally collaborate with stakeholders across the Enterprise teams. It is an Individual contributor role. We are seeking a detail-oriented and forward-thinking Data Steward to support the development and governance of data powering **agentic AI systems** —AI agents capable of autonomous decision-making and task execution. This role ensures data quality, integrity, compliance, and usability across the lifecycle of intelligent agents. This role will work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, product teams, and governance stakeholders to maintain trustworthy, well-structured, and ethically managed datasets that drive reliable agent behaviour.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Define and implement data quality rules (schema validation, referential integrity, distribution checks, drift detection) using Data Quality tools.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers to define and monitor data quality metrics (accuracy, completeness, consistency) essential for high-performing, unbiased AI agents and their tools.
* Monitor dataset health metrics (null ratios, entropy, cardinality, outliers) and set up alerting mechanisms.
* Implement end-to-end **data lineage** across ingestion transformation feature stores model inputs agent outputs.
* Use observability tools (Monte Carlo, etc) to trace data dependencies impacting agent decisions
* Support root cause analysis of agent failures linked to upstream data issues.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Legal/Compliance, and Business Process Owners regarding all data-related aspects of Agentic AI solutions.
* Maintain **data catalogs and semantic layers** (Collibra, Alation, etc)
* Ensure interoperability across structured data and unstructured data.
* Ensure all data practices related to Agentic AI comply with internal policies and external regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA), paying close attention to the unique compliance risks of autonomous data use
* Establish and enforce data governance policies, standards, and procedures uniquely tailored for AI agents, including data collection, usage, sharing, and retention protocols specific to autonomous and multi-agent systems.
* Enforce **data access controls** , masking, and PII handling in accordance with regulations.
* Maintain audit trails for data used in agent decisions (critical for explainability and compliance).
* Develop and execute procedures for Annual Attestation for Unstructured Data Management Plans (DMP) and Agentic AI Data Management Plans (ADMPs)
* Support DMP/ADMP automation initiatives across BQ, Agentic AI, and other applicable areas of data governance
Establish audit compliance methodology and communication processes (e.g., all data sources/agents have DMP/ADMP, cataloguing of all AI agents, attestation completion)  

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

  
Bachelor's degree and 8-10 years of total experience  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Strong SQL and working knowledge of Python for data processing
* Experience with Data Modeling, schema design and data validation frameworks.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Data Governance strategies and processes
* Experience with Data Analysis, Data Visualization, Data Observability, Data versioning, End to End Process mindset, Lineage.
* Exposure to Database Technologies (GCP, Cloud, etc)
* Exposure to Agile Methodologies (ADO, etc)
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive change within their domain
* Solid communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience and competence in leading, influencing, coaching and mentoring others
* Attention to detail with the ability to identify patterns and inconsistencies

* Engage service provider executives and senior technical stakeholders to understand strategic priorities, operational challenges, and transformation goals. Explore areas of focus and uncover customer pain points. * Enable field teams and customers through workshops, executive briefings, architecture sessions, demonstrations, and industry engagements.
* Identify repeatable patterns and differentiated use cases across various domains including 5G, cloud, OSS/BSS, network automation, observability, cybersecurity, and customer experience.
* Work with service providers to identify, shape, and solution API monetisation services. Connect business opportunities to architectures that expose network and digital capabilities through APIs, and consider the supporting data, analytics, security, integration, and operational requirements needed to deliver customer and partner value.
* Contribute to thought leadership through customer presentations, white papers, industry forums, and events such as TM Forum and Mobile World Congress.
* Bring external market, technology, and customer insights back into business strategy, solution development, and field enablement.

**Success Measures:**  

* Establishing trusted relationships with senior service provider stakeholders.
* Creating differentiated data and AI architecture strategies, designs, use cases and prototypes that address real operational and business challenges.
* Influencing customer adoption of modern data platform capabilities.
* Enabling account teams and partners to have stronger, more strategic customer conversations.
* Building repeatable service provider use cases and architecture patterns that can be rolled out to others.
* Strengthening the organisation’s position as a thought leader in service provider data-driven transformation.

The ideal candidate can move comfortably from a product discussion to an industry conversation to an enterprise data and transformation strategy-design and should be able to build prototypes when needed.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 12+ years experience in the telecommunications or service provider industry, with credibility across network, cloud, operations, assurance, automation, security, or customer experience domains.
* Deep experience in one or two service provider domains, combined with a sound working understanding of the others. Relevant domains include fixed wireline, wireless, mobile core, RAN, packet core, optical, transport/IP, 5G, network functions virtualization, cloud-native networking, OSS/BSS, network automation, and service assurance.
* The ability to communicate effectively with service provider executives, enterprise architects, network architects, NOC/SOC leaders, operations teams, and engineering organizations.
* Experience developing or influencing complex solution architectures in large-scale, multi-domain environments, and the ability to connect business outcomes and operational challenges to platform capabilities and architecture decisions.
* A strong understanding of data platforms, data architecture, telemetry, observability, analytics, AI, or security data solutions. Experience with Splunk or other enterprise data, observability, analytics, cloud, or security platforms is valuable.
* Knowledge of Cisco and other technologies and architectures relevant to service providers, as well as an understanding of autonomous and agentic architectures.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Strong executive handling, consulting skills, storytelling ability, and confidence leading strategic customer conversations. Experience working across sales, presales, product, engineering, delivery, and customer success teams is valuable.
* A curious, collaborative, and commercially minded approach, with the ability to operate across strategic and technical conversations.
* Experience advising customers on platform adoption, operating models, data governance, or transformation roadmaps. A background in enterprise architecture, consulting, technical sales, solution architecture, or senior customer advisory roles is valuable.
* Familiarity with TM Forum frameworks, Open APIs, industry standards, or service provider transformation programmes.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

description:

Are you curious, enthusiastic about infrastructure, and ready to solve complex challenges in the AI era? Join us as a **Cloud & AI Solution Engineer - Infrastructure** focused on the **Azure Platform** for **commercial customers** at Microsoft.

In this technical sales role, you will help customers design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures that support their modernization goals. Using Azure’s IaaS and PaaS services, you will guide organizations through migration, modernization, optimization, and innovation—translating technical capabilities into significant business outcomes.

You will collaborate across teams to deliver impactful solutions that enhance agility, reduce costs, and unlock value through AI-powered infrastructure.

As a Cloud & AI Digital Solution Engineer for the Azure Platform, you will play a key role in helping customers modernize their infrastructure and unlock the full value of Microsoft’s cloud. You will work directly with technical and business stakeholders to design and implement secure, scalable, and resilient architectures that support AI workloads and business-critical applications.

You bring deep expertise in migrating core workloads—including Windows, SQL Server, Linux, PostgreSQL, and Oracle—to Azure. Beyond migration, you lead customers through modernization using the 6R strategy, containerization best practices, and Azure-native services like AKS and Arc, while exploring how AI and intelligent agents can accelerate legacy transformation.  
You also apply strong networking knowledge to design hybrid and cloud-native solutions, including virtual networks, VPNs, and secure routing architectures that meet enterprise performance and compliance needs. You complement this with trusted partner solutions like NetApp, VMware, RedHat, and SAP to ensure a secure, optimized, and scalable migration experience.

As you join the team, You will have the opportunity to grow your technical expertise with access to a wide range of Microsoft learning resources—including support for earning industry-recognized certifications across Azure infrastructure, security, and AI.  
  
With a solid understanding of Azure security services and compliance frameworks you will help customers meet regulatory requirements and build Cloud environments that are ready for the future.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Drive technical sales by using technical demos, proofs of concept, and technical architecture accelerators to influence solution design and enable deployments.

* Build trusted relationships with platforms leads to co-design secure, scalable solutions.

* Deepen knowledge of enterprise apps (SAP, Oracle) and Azure VMware Solution (AVS).

**Qualifications**  

* 5+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience
  + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience
  + OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3+ year(s) technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience
  + OR equivalent experience
* Proven experience in cloud infrastructure, including migration of workloads such as Windows, SQL, Linux, and PostgreSQL.
* Experience designing or selling solutions involving hybrid networking, secure connectivity, or network performance optimization in enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), App Platform, and containerization strategies.
* Strong understanding of Azure services, including security, compliance, and hybrid cloud scenarios.
* Ability to engage technical and business stakeholders to design and deploy scalable, secure cloud solutions.

* 6+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience
  + OR equivalent experience
* 4+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructure, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, and ISVs like NetApp, VMware, and RedHat.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Build robust data foundations that power analytics and intelligent applications. title: Lead AI Engagement Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.

The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It combines architecture and engineering with a set of functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the demand side: what gets built, why it is worth building, whether anyone uses it, and whether it actually works once live.

 **Job Description**

The **Lead AI Engagement Specialist** owns a portfolio of AI workflows within one or more business functions, end to end. You will identify where AI genuinely changes how the work is done, redesign that work, write the PRD, drive the build with the architect and engineers, land the adoption, and then manage the performance of the agents in production as a product you are accountable for.

This is a product and transformation role, not a business analysis role. The distinction matters and we mean it: you will own a roadmap, write specifications precise enough to build from, make scope calls, and be measured on realised value rather than on delivered documentation. If a workflow does not clear its quality bar or nobody uses it, that is your problem to solve, not to report.

**Where this role sits**

**Reports to:** Head of the AI Centre of Excellence

**Alignment:** Dotted line to the leadership of the business function you cover

**Works with:** AI Engagement specialists, Lead AI Architect and Senior AI Engineer daily; external implementation partners; Security, GRC, Legal and Data teams as required

**Owns:** The prioritised workflow pipeline, PRDs, roadmap, adoption and live agent performance for one function. Lead & manage other AI Engagement specialists.

**Accountable for:** Realised, measured business value — not deployment count

**What you will own**

**Opportunity identification and prioritisation**

* Own the AI workflow pipeline for your function — a ranked, evidence-based view of where AI creates value, refreshed as the business and the technology move.
* Distinguish rigorously between work that AI genuinely changes and work that merely looks automatable in a demo — and be willing to argue that a well-sponsored idea is not worth building.
* Prioritise on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and time to impact, in partnership with the architect.

**Process discovery and workflow redesign**

* Map the current state properly: volumes, cycle times, cost to serve, exception paths, decision points, systems and data touched, and where the work actually breaks — grounded in observation and data, not in what the process document claims.
* Redesign the work, not just the tool. Decide what the agent does, what the human does, where the handoff sits, what the escalation path is, and what changes in roles, policies, SOPs and controls as a consequence.
* Design the human-in-the-loop model with the architect: where review is mandatory, where an agent may act autonomously, and how a wrong action is caught and reversed.

**Business case and value ownership**

* Build the business case: baseline metrics, benefit hypothesis, quantified target, build and run cost, payback and sensitivity — and the honest version of it, including the case against building.
* Establish the baseline before launch. A benefit that cannot be measured against a pre-existing baseline will not be believed, and should not be.
* Own benefits realisation after go-live — report the real number, including when it is below target, and recommend iterate, rebuild or retire accordingly.

**Product specification and roadmap**

* Write the PRD: problem, users, scope and non-scope, target workflow, acceptance criteria, quality bar, data and system dependencies, non-functional expectations, risks, and success metrics — detailed enough that the architect and engineers can design and build from it without a translation layer.
* Own the roadmap for your function: sequencing, dependencies, release planning, and a defensible view of what comes next and why.
* Partner with delivery daily — make scope calls, resolve ambiguity, unblock, test, and accept. Be available to engineers at the pace they work.

**Agent performance management**

* Define the quality bar in measurable terms with engineering — what a correct output is, what an acceptable error rate is, and what failure mode is unacceptable at any rate.
* Build and curate the evaluation datasets for your workflows, drawing on real cases from your function.
* Review live agent output on an ongoing basis and run the feedback loop back into engineering.
* Monitor production performance — accuracy and quality, containment or deflection, escalation rate, latency, cost per transaction, and user satisfaction — and drive the iteration cycle.
* Treat a live agent as a product under active management, not a project that was completed.

**Adoption and change**

* Own adoption as an outcome you are measured on: enablement, training, communications, champions, policy and SOP updates, and management routines.
* Instrument usage and act on what it shows — including the uncomfortable finding that a well-built workflow is being avoided.
* Engage with resistance seriously. Where people are working around the agent, understand why before attempting to change the behaviour.
* Work with function leadership on role definition, capacity and performance expectations as work is redesigned.

**Governance and CoE contribution**

* Ensure workflows meet responsible AI, data handling, privacy and approval requirements, working with Security, GRC and Legal.
* Feed reusable patterns back into the CoE so that a solved problem in one function does not get re-solved from scratch in another.

 **Qualifications**

* 7+ years in product management, business or digital transformation, operations strategy, or top-tier consulting — with a track record of change that shipped and stuck, not recommendations that were accepted.
* Demonstrable ownership of product specifications or PRDs that engineering teams built from. We will ask to discuss one in detail.
* Strong process redesign capability. Lean, Six Sigma, service design or similar training is welcome; evidence of redesigned work in production matters more than certification.
* Business case and value modelling — comfort with baselines, unit economics, cost to serve and payback, and the intellectual honesty to model the downside.
* Data literacy: able to interrogate data, work with BI tooling, and define and track metrics that hold up to scrutiny.
* Working fluency in what current AI systems can and cannot do — retrieval, agents, hallucination and grounding, evaluation, human-in-the-loop, and cost. Enough to scope realistically with engineers and to push back on hype and on pessimism with equal confidence. Coding is not required.
* Change management and adoption experience with real end users, including users who did not ask for the change.
* Strong influence at senior levels without formal authority, and the standing to tell a function leader that their favourite idea is not the right first build.
* Excellent written communication — clear specifications, clear reasoning, clear status.

This role requires credibility with practitioners and leaders inside the function from the first week. We are looking for someone who understands how the work is genuinely done — its operating rhythm, its systems, its economics and its performance measures — well enough to challenge how it is done today rather than to describe it.

**Strongly preferred**

* Experience operating across multiple regions and time zones.

**What this role is not**

* Not a process documentation role. Mapping is an input; redesigned, adopted, measured work is the output.
* Not a change communications role. You own the product, not the announcement.
* Not a requirements-gathering role. You will not hand a wish list to engineering and wait; you will specify, decide and stay accountable through production.

* The first one or two PRDs written and accepted into build by the architect and engineering without a translation gap.

**First 6 months**

* First workflows live in production, with adoption instrumented and quality actively monitored.
* A functioning feedback loop between live agent performance and the engineering backlog.
* A 12-month roadmap for your function that leadership has signed up to.

**First 12 months**

* Measured, defensible business value delivered against pre-established baselines — reported honestly, including where the result fell short.
* Adoption at a level where the redesigned workflow is the normal way the work is done, not an optional tool.
* At least one reusable pattern contributed to the CoE and adopted by another function.
* A function that is materially more capable of absorbing the next wave than it was when you joined.

**How we assess**

* Portfolio conversation — a transformation or product initiative you owned end to end, including the value actually realised versus the value forecast.
* Written exercise — a short PRD or workflow redesign on a realistic problem from your function.
* Working session with the AI CoE on scoping and quality definition for a live QAD workflow.

title: Director,DBRE
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**The Opportunity**
===================

Qualys runs one of the largest and most complex data platforms in the enterprise security industry — a massive Oracle and Exadata estate at the core, surrounded by a self-managed open-source big data fabric: Kafka, Hadoop, Cassandra, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, and Kubernetes. These systems directly underpin the product SLAs we deliver to 10,000+ customers worldwide.

We are looking for a Director of Database Reliability Engineering who combines deep technical craft with the leadership instinct to scale a team and the builder's mindset to ship systems that eliminate toil. You don't have to be the world's leading expert in every technology on the stack — but you must carry genuine depth in Oracle or large-scale distributed data systems, with strong working knowledge across the broader ecosystem, and the intellectual range to go deep where the situation demands it. We do not expect day-one mastery across every system; we expect depth in core areas and the proven ability to rapidly develop expertise where the platform needs it.

This role directly owns database platform operations and reliability practices, and influences adjacent infrastructure and application teams through technical credibility and cross-functional partnership. You will lead a team of ~30, serve as the final technical escalation point for the data platform, and shape the multi-year strategy for how Qualys builds, automates, and evolves its data infrastructure.

**Core Focus Areas**
====================

This is a wide-scope role. Here is how candidates should prioritize their self-evaluation:

**01** **Oracle + Distributed Systems Technical Depth** — Deep in one, strong across the other — enough to lead architecture and hold the team accountable

**02** **Data Platform Reliability & Incident Ownership** — SLOs, escalation authority, DR, predictive capacity — the foundational mandate

**03** **AI-Driven Automation & Toil Elimination** — Building and shipping agents, not just evaluating tools — measurable impact on MTTR and operational load

**04** **Team Leadership & Org Development** — Managing ~30 across ICs and managers; building culture, career ladders, and hiring bar

**05** **Vendor Management & Cost Optimization** — Oracle relationship, licensing discipline, and infrastructure cost efficiency

**What Makes This Role Unique**
===============================

* **Breadth of scope, depth of ownership** — You hold the charter for Oracle/Exadata AND the full open-source big data stack — accountable for reliability across all of it
* **Build AI systems, not just use them** — We expect shipped production tooling — AI agents, autonomous remediation, intelligent observability — not proof-of-concept demos
* **Strategy and execution in equal measure** — You will define the multi-year data platform roadmap and then make it happen — this is not a pure operations role
* **Real cross-functional influence** — Data reliability touches every product team; this role earns authority through technical credibility, not org chart position
* **A platform worth modernizing** — Battle-tested at scale, with genuine complexity — and a leadership team committed to doing it right

**What You Will Build**
=======================

Beyond running the platform, we expect this leader to leave a concrete engineering footprint. Examples of the systems we want this role to build and own:

* **AI-assisted incident triage system** — LLM-powered log analysis and alert summarization that cuts triage time from minutes to seconds
* **Autonomous remediation agents** — Self-healing workflows for common failure patterns — space exhaustion, replication lag, lock contention, consumer group lag — with safe human escalation fallback
* **Natural-language operational query interface** — Engineers ask questions in plain English; the system queries metrics, logs, and configuration state to answer
* **Predictive capacity and anomaly models** — ML-driven forecasting for Oracle tablespace growth, Kafka partition pressure, and Cassandra compaction backlog
* **Reliability-as-code pipeline gates** — Automated schema review, load test, and regression detection integrated into CI/CD so reliability issues are caught before production

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Own the Data Platform Reliability Charter**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and drive SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets across Oracle, Exadata, Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, and Kubernetes-hosted data services
* Serve as the final technical escalation point for all P0/P1 incidents; lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent resolution — not workarounds
* Own disaster recovery architecture, backup integrity standards, and data durability SLAs — validated through regular DR exercises
* Establish predictive capacity planning and performance baselines across the full data platform footprint
* Drive cost efficiency and infrastructure utilization optimization — right-sizing resources, eliminating idle capacity, and building chargeback/showback visibility for leadership

**Define and Execute the Multi-Year Data Platform Strategy**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Develop and own a multi-year DBRE roadmap — covering reliability targets, modernization priorities, platform consolidation opportunities, and AI automation milestones
* Drive platform evolution decisions: when to standardize, when to consolidate, when to retire, and when to invest in new capabilities
* Provide architectural guidance for major data platform initiatives — schema design, topology changes, new technology adoption, and migration planning
* Partner with Product Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure leadership to embed reliability and cost constraints into platform direction from day one

**Go Deep on Oracle and Exadata**
---------------------------------

* Carry deep technical authority for Oracle Database (19c+), RAC, Data Guard, RMAN, and Exadata — sufficient to lead architecture reviews, diagnose production incidents, and hold senior engineers accountable
* Drive query optimization, AWR/ASH-based diagnostics, execution plan analysis, and schema design reviews for mission-critical OLTP and analytical workloads
* Manage Oracle vendor relationships with technical and commercial depth: negotiate support contracts, challenge licensing interpretations, escalate through Oracle's senior channels, and ensure Qualys negotiates from a position of knowledge
* Own Oracle licensing compliance end-to-end — a material financial and risk area requiring both engineering precision and commercial acumen
* Lead Exadata patching cadence, storage cell failure playbooks, IORM policy tuning, and hardware lifecycle planning

**Lead the Open-Source Big Data Platform**
------------------------------------------

* Architect and operate Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, and Ceph deployments — self-managed at scale, not cloud-managed services
* Apply strong distributed systems fundamentals — consensus and replication models, storage I/O patterns, network latency sensitivity, and horizontal scaling — to architectural decisions that hold under load
* Partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering on Kubernetes-native stateful workloads: operators, persistent volumes, storage class optimization, and capacity planning
* Drive standardization of runbooks, alerting, and operational playbooks across all technologies — documented, automated, no tribal knowledge

**Build AI-Powered Reliability Systems**
----------------------------------------

* Design and ship AI agents that automate tier-1 database operational toil — systems running in production with measurable impact on MTTR and alert noise
* Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) into operational workflows for log triage, incident summarization, runbook execution, and anomaly-triggered decision support
* Evaluate AIOps platforms and observability tooling with engineering rigor — quantify the actual value, not the vendor pitch
* Embed reliability-by-design upstream: schema review gates, load test automation, and database performance regression detection in CI/CD pipelines

**Lead and Develop the DBRE Team**
----------------------------------

* Manage, mentor, and develop ~30 DBAs, SREs, and data platform engineers across individual contributors and engineering managers
* Define hiring standards, career ladders, and team structure that attract and retain senior database and reliability talent
* Build a culture of technical rigor, blameless learning, and relentless automation — where manual toil is a bug, not a process
* Eliminate single points of knowledge failure through documentation, cross-training, and disciplined on-call rotation design
* Own workforce planning: headcount forecasting, skills gap analysis, and building specialist sub-teams as the platform evolves

**How We Measure Success**
==========================

* **Platform Availability** — SLO attainment across all data services — reduction in unplanned production incidents attributable to DBRE gaps
* **MTTA / MTTR** — Measurable improvement in time to detect and resolve incidents, accelerated by AI tooling
* **Automation Coverage** — Percentage of tier-1 operational tasks eliminated through shipped agents and tooling
* **Cost Efficiency** — Infrastructure utilization rates, Oracle licensing optimization, and idle/over-provisioned resource reduction
* **Team Health & Retention** — On-call load reduction, career growth trajectory, and senior IC/manager retention
* **Platform Strategy Execution** — Multi-year roadmap milestones delivered; capacity forecasts validated against actual growth

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

**Must Have**
-------------

* 15+ years in database engineering, reliability engineering, or data platform operations — with 5+ years leading multi-person teams including at least one layer of managers
* Deep expertise in Oracle or large-scale distributed data systems, with strong working knowledge across the broader ecosystem (Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, Kubernetes)
* Strong distributed systems fundamentals — replication and consensus models, storage I/O, network latency tradeoffs, and scaling patterns for stateful workloads — applied to real production decisions
* Shipped operational tooling or agents using LLM APIs with measurable impact (MTTR reduction, toil elimination, alert noise reduction) — production systems, not proofs of concept
* Oracle vendor relationship management — commercial negotiation, license compliance ownership, and technical escalation through Oracle's support and sales organizations
* Infrastructure cost control — hands-on experience right-sizing compute and storage, eliminating idle capacity, and building cost visibility (chargeback/showback) across database infrastructure
* Track record leading teams of 15+ engineers with both IC and manager-level reports; experience growing technical talent and building hiring bars
* Executive communication skills — translating database risk, reliability posture, and investment needs to C-suite audiences with clarity and commercial grounding
* Experience serving as final escalation point for production data platform incidents — with the technical depth to diagnose, direct, and close

**Strong Plus**
---------------

* Exadata-specific depth: IORM policy tuning, smart scan diagnostics, storage server failure recovery, and hardware lifecycle decision-making
* Kubernetes-native data platform experience with stateful workload operators (Strimzi, Cassandra Operator, OpenSearch Operator, Redis Operator)
* Experience with AIOps or observability platforms (Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) including custom exporter and agent development
* Familiarity with agentic integration patterns (MCP, tool-use APIs) for building AI-augmented operational toolchains
* Hands-on coding in Python, Go, or shell scripting — enough to design and ship internal tooling independently
* Background in security or compliance-adjacent industries where data integrity and auditability carry regulatory weight

**Who This Role Is For**
========================

This role is for a data platform leader who still gets pulled in by a gnarly execution plan, and who sees a recurring on-call alert as a signal that something needs to be built — then builds it. You lead by doing as much as by directing, and your team follows you because they know you have sat in their chair.

You hold Oracle's feet to the fire in a negotiation and hold your engineers to a high bar in a design review. You speak reliability to a DBA and business risk to a CFO. You don't wait to be handed a mandate — you see the gap, take the charter, and grow the team around it. You balance operating rigorously today with shaping the platform for where the business will be in three years.

If you are energized by owning something truly foundational — the data layer that everything else at Qualys depends on — and you want to build the next generation of AI-driven reliability engineering, we would like to hear from you.

**This Role Is Not For**
------------------------

* DBAs focused on ticket-based operations who are not comfortable driving architectural decisions and organizational change
* Leaders who are not hands-on in production systems — this role requires genuine technical engagement, not just team management
* Candidates whose AI experience is limited to tool adoption — we need operators who have shipped agents and measured the impact
* Candidates who need full-stack mastery on day one — we value depth in core areas and intellectual range over checklist coverage

**About Qualys**
================

Qualys, Inc. (NASDAQ: QLYS) is a pioneer and leading provider of disruptive cloud-based security, compliance, and IT solutions with more than 10,000 subscription customers worldwide, including a majority of the Forbes Global 100 and Fortune 100. Qualys helps organizations streamline and automate their security and compliance solutions onto a single platform for greater agility, better business outcomes, and substantial cost savings.

title: Senior Databricks and AI Engineer
description:
#### **Job Summary:**

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Databricks and AI Engineer to join our growing data engineering team. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in designing, building, and deploying scalable data solutions on the Databricks platform. A critical requirement for this role is demonstrated experience in migrating and modernizing SQL Server environments to Databricks, including data transformation, performance optimization, and ensuring data integrity. This role will also involve developing and implementing AI/ML solutions leveraging Databricks capabilities.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

### **1. Databricks Platform Expertise**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines on Databricks using Spark, Python, Scala, and SQL.
* Optimize Databricks cluster performance, job execution, and cost efficiency.
* Implement data governance, security, and access control best practices on the Databricks Lakehouse.
* Work with Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and other Databricks data management features.

### **2. SQL Server to Databricks Migration**

* Lead and execute the migration of data and workloads from on-premises SQL Server databases to the Databricks Lakehouse.
* Develop strategies for schema conversion, data ingestion, and transformation from SQL Server to Delta Lake format.
* Identify and implement performance tuning strategies for migrated SQL workloads on Databricks.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and completeness throughout the migration process.
* Develop and execute comprehensive testing plans to validate migrated data and functionality.

### **3. AI/ML Development**

* Collaborate with data scientists and stakeholders to operationalize AI/ML models on Databricks.
* Develop and deploy machine learning pipelines, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and inference.
* Utilize Databricks MLflow for experiment tracking, model management, and deployment.
* Explore and implement advanced AI/ML techniques relevant to business needs.

### **4. Collaboration and Leadership**

* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the team's technical growth.
* Work closely with data architects, data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and documentation for data engineering processes and solutions.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex data-related issues.

### **5. Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, with a strong focus on cloud-based data platforms.
* **Mandatory:** Proven, hands-on experience migrating complex SQL Server environments to cloud-based data warehouses or lake houses, specifically Databricks.
* **Mandatory:** Deep expertise in Databricks platform, including Spark, Delta Lake, SQL Analytics, and Databricks Runtime.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and SQL. Experience with Scala is a plus.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, data modeling, ETL/ELT best practices, and database performance tuning.
* Experience with AI/ML workflows, MLOps, and tools like MLflow.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their data services.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

### **6. Preferred Skills**

* Databricks certifications.
* Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Knowledge of other database technologies.
* Experience with CI/CD practices for data pipelines.

* Lead infrastructure-as-code with Terraform: reusable modules, standards and clean, repeatable environments

* Set up observability (logs, metrics, traces) and operational tooling

An inclusive, collaborative culture where you don't need to conform to succeed, where people support one another and feel comfortable being themselves.

title: Technical Engineering Manager_Core AI
description:
As an AI Engineering Manager on our Core AI team in India, you will be a cornerstone of FloQast's AI transformation and a key leader in our growing global engineering organization. You will manage and scale a team of high-performing software and AI engineers responsible for architecting and deploying production AI systems—powering our accounting automation platform and bringing our vision of an AI accountant teammate to life.

This role requires a balance between people leadership, operational excellence, and technical leadership in modern AI paradigms. You will partner with global engineering leadership, product management, and architecture teams to establish technical standards for agentic workflows, model context protocols (MCP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and LLMOps across FloQast. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will play a critical role in expanding FloQast’s AI footprint by recruiting, mentoring, and developing top-tier engineering talent in India.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* **Team Leadership & Development:** Lead, manage, mentor, and develop teams of AI software engineers. Grow your team members’ career paths through consistent coaching, performance management, and continuous feedback.
* **AI Technical Direction & Delivery:** Guide your team in the architecture and delivery of scalable production AI products, including intelligent chatbots, document processing systems, and agentic workflows using Python and modern AI frameworks.
* **Recruiting & Site Growth:** Actively recruit, interview, and retain top-tier AI engineering talent to build out FloQast's Core AI capabilities in India.
* **Global Collaboration:** Collaborate effectively with product managers, QA, architecture, security, and global engineering leaders to design and implement our centralized AI platform (model routing, provider management, vector search).
* **Process & Culture:** Cultivate an engineering culture of innovative, egoless, high-trust problem solving. Champion lean software development, Agile principles, and robust LLMOps/DevOps practices for AI systems.
* **Production Excellence:** Ensure your team builds robust, compliant, and observable AI products that integrate seamlessly with diverse technologies (accounting systems, external APIs) in a B2B SaaS environment.

### **What You'll Bring**

* **5+ years of software engineering management experience,** with a track record of leading teams to deliver complex backend or AI products to a paying customer base.
* **5+ years of experience as an individual contributor** as a software engineer, with a strong background in Python, backend development, and cloud-native environments (AWS preferred).
* **Production AI Experience:** Familiarity with LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), conversational AI, and scalable system design for AI products.
* **Distributed Team Leadership:** Proven experience leading and managing teams that are geographically distributed, driving alignment across time zones.
* **Recruiting & Mentorship:** Hands-on experience recruiting and interviewing engineering personnel, alongside a strong track record of managing individuals' performance and career growth.
* **Agile & Delivery Mastery:** 5+ years working on teams using Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) with a strong commitment to automated testing, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* **Communication & Alignment:** Strong ability to communicate complex system designs and AI strategies to both technical and business stakeholders.

### **Nice To Haves**

* Experience managing managers of software engineering teams.
* Hands-on experience with advanced RAG architectures, reranking systems, semantic search systems, or AI observability/monitoring tools.
* Experience working on B2B SaaS products, particularly in the financial or accounting space.
* Familiarity with our broader web stack (MongoDB, Express, React, and Node) to facilitate seamless integration between AI services and core applications.
* Knowledge of model context protocols (MCP) or reinforcement learning techniques (RLHF).

FloQast is the leading AI-powered Accounting Transformation Platform, uniquely built by former accountants for accountants. We automate complex, recurring accounting workflows—transforming preparers into strategic reviewers and relieving accountants from tedious manual work.
